text:
Naveen (AE): Incoming RFP from AtlasBank asking for EU-only POC. Key asks: tenant pinned to eu-central-1, EU-only control plane, BYOK with HSM import, telemetry/audit logs must remain in EU, and 36mo audit retention. Need a concise presales handoff for procurement by EOD.
Zoe (SE): Quick Q - does procurement require subprocessors limited to EU legal entities or just EU-hosted infra?
Naveen (AE): They explicitly said no subprocessors outside the EU for this engagement if possible. Also they'll want SCC reference and a subprocessors snapshot.
Ibrahim (infra): Tech note: We can spin an EU-only control plane in eu-central-1 for the POC. BYOK HSM import requires Dedicated or Private so customer keys stay in their KMS/HSM. Hosted can use our EU KMS (eu-west-1) but that does not meet HSM import ask.
Greta (sre): Observability: our default monitoring exports to a US-based SaaS. For this POC we can disable external exports and route metrics to EU-only stack. Ops change needed.
OpsBot: Ticket created #12844 - "atlasbank-eu-poc-geo-lock". Assignee: Ibrahim. ETA 48h for ops checklist and telemetry isolation.
Helena (legal): I'll need subprocessors export (snapshot), SCC references, and proposed DPA language for 36mo retention. Note our standard hosted audit retention is 12mo; 36mo will be an addendum with costs. Also need confirmation of deletion receipts and audit export format.
Zoe (SE): Drafting one-pager with routing sample, BYOK/HSM options, VPC peering checklist, telemetry toggle steps, subprocessors link, and ballpark POC pricing. Will upload to Drive and paste link here.
Naveen (AE): Ballpark number? Procurement expects a single-line estimate now.
Ibrahim (infra): Rough POC pricing: Hosted EU-only telemetry isolation 2-week eval ~USD 19k total. Dedicated/Private with BYOK HSM import + 1mo reserved small pool ~USD 30k/mo. 36mo archival add-on roughly USD 2k/mo (depends on volume). Finalize after sizing.
Zoe (SE): Sample routing payload for RFP (paste as-is):
```json
{
  "tenant": "atlasbank-poc",
  "routing": {
    "mode": "pin",
    "primary_region": "eu-central-1",
    "failover_regions": ["eu-west-1"],
    "egress_policy": "restrict_to_allowed_regions"
  },
  "kms": {
    "mode": "BYOK",
    "hsm_import_required": true,
    "key_location": "customer-kms-eu"
  }
}
```
Zoe (SE): Quick curl for SE testing (paste into docs):
```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/tenants \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"name":"atlasbank-poc","routing":{"primary":"eu-central-1","failover":["eu-west-1"]},"kms":{"type":"BYOK","region":"eu-west-1","hsm":true}}'
```
Greta (sre): If they want VPC peering collect CIDR ranges + NOC contact. Also confirm they do NOT want DB replicas outside EU  that will affect how we configure storage replication.
Naveen (AE): I'll ask for CIDRs and their SIG questionnaire now. @Helena I'll DM the SIG when I get it.
Helena (legal): Thanks. Once I review SIG I'll flag DPA exceptions and put together addendum language for the 36mo retention and EU-only control plane.
Ibrahim (infra): Note: to meet "no subprocessors outside EU" strictly we must avoid some vendor plugins (alerts, SMS) that operate globally. For POC we can disable those and use EU-local alternatives; ops ticket covers this.
Zoe (SE): Uploaded one-pager + price sketch to Drive: https://drive.redwood/POC/AtlasBank-EU. Includes subprocessors snapshot, ops checklist, and acceptance criteria for the POC.
Naveen (AE): Perfect. Target to attach to RFP by EOD. Anything else blocking?
Greta (sre): Schedule perf window during POC to run e2e latency tests from their EU infra. I'll coordinate once tenant is provisioned.
Naveen (AE): Got it, will propose perf windows in kickoff invite. Thanks everyone! :raised_hands:
